subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

PERSEVERANCE
solution:
The correct answer is- 'indifference'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given word:
 
• The word perseverance is a noun and it means *continued effort to do or achieve something, even when this is difficult or takes a long time. *(कुछ करने या हासिल करने के लिए निरंतर प्रयास, भले ही यह कठिन हो या लंबा समय लगे।)
 
 
• Example: *It took a lot of patience and **perseverance **for all sides to reach an agreement.*
 
 
 
• By this meaning, we can say that 'indifference' is the opposite word to 'perseverance.'

Thus *option 4 *is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The synonyms of the given word are:

 
 
• Dedication, Determination, Tenacity
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options is:
 
 
• indifference - The trait of lacking enthusiasm for or interest in things generally (आम तौर पर चीजों के लिए उत्साह या रुचि की कमी होना)
 
• determination - The quality of being determined to do or achieve something (कुछ हासिल करने के लिए दृढ़ निश्चयी होना)
 
• dedication - The act of binding yourself to a course of action (अपने आप को एक क्रिया के लिए बाध्य करने का कार्य)
 
• **tenacity - **Persistent determination (निरंतर दृढ़ संकल्प)
